children.name:
Make the existing channel the shared working context. Authorize limited
      local runner sessions on behalf of a current human, preserve parallel
      participation, and coordinate execution through owner-defined ports.
      Own explicit agent questions and their atomically limited conversation
      budget without interpreting ordinary conversation text as commands.
terms:
"
      Make the existing channel the shared working context. Authorize limited
      local runner sessions on behalf of a current human, preserve parallel
      participation, and coordinate execution through owner-defined ports.
      Own explicit agent questions and their atomically limited conversation
      budget without interpreting ordinary conversation text as commands.
      "
"Use SpaceId as channel identity; execution and delegation identifiers identify technical activity only."
"Project, team, workstream and ordinary channels can support concurrent work, including channels without tickets."
"Never introduce a second job identity, reservation or exclusive assignee for the same channel."
"Recheck an opaque human session and issue a separate limited delegation bound to its runner and pinned agent."
"A personal agent can act for its human in one channel without administrative permanent channel admission."
"Never authenticate from submitted principal identifiers, fabricate agent membership, or widen human rights or snapshot capabilities."
"Coordinate starts, linked continuations and publication through small execution, history and messaging owner ports."
"ChannelWork owns collaboration authority while AgentExecution, RunHistory and Messaging retain their persistence and lifecycle."
"Never write another owner's entities or inject concrete repositories and service locators into collaboration behavior."

children.name: Personal-agent questions persist the exact confirmed target history and target runner with replyRunId None. Pending availability is durable and visible only through the recipient's own current channel delegation. Permanent participation retains autonomous dispatch.
terms: "Personal-agent questions persist the exact confirmed target history and target runner with replyRunId None. Pending availability is durable and visible only through the recipient's own current channel delegation. Permanent participation retains autonomous dispatch."

children.name: acceptAgentReply rechecks the recipient runner, agent, channel, human standing, pinned snapshot, effective capabilities and confirmed workspace. It starts one linked execution using an explicit new runtimeSessionReference; retries preserve its identity and do not consume budget again. A sender credential never authorizes the recipient.
terms: "acceptAgentReply rechecks the recipient runner, agent, channel, human standing, pinned snapshot, effective capabilities and confirmed workspace. It starts one linked execution using an explicit new runtimeSessionReference; retries preserve its identity and do not consume budget again. A sender credential never authorizes the recipient."

children.name: Agent answers must be immutable messages of the new reply execution, actually authored by the target agent and persisted after the question. Earlier target summaries cannot answer a later request.
terms: "Agent answers must be immutable messages of the new reply execution, actually authored by the target agent and persisted after the question. Earlier target summaries cannot answer a later request."

children.name: I01-I02: SpaceId is channel identity. Project, team, workstream and ordinary channels, including channels without tickets or workstreams, remain selectable and executable. Ticket and workstream mutations still require their real domain identities.
terms: "I01-I02: SpaceId is channel identity. Project, team, workstream and ordinary channels, including channels without tickets or workstreams, remain selectable and executable. Ticket and workstream mutations still require their real domain identities."

children.name: I03-I06: Listing, reading, selecting, opening a delegation, announcing work and completing a run neither reserve a channel nor assign an exclusive worker. Parallel humans, sessions and runs are allowed. Conversation text never changes Ticket readiness, Workstream stage or ownership; only explicit owner operations do.
terms: "I03-I06: Listing, reading, selecting, opening a delegation, announcing work and completing a run neither reserve a channel nor assign an exclusive worker. Parallel humans, sessions and runs are allowed. Conversation text never changes Ticket readiness, Workstream stage or ownership; only explicit owner operations do."

children.name: I07-I09: ExecutionGateway calls AgentExecution's owner operation with an immutable ChannelSession origin and instruction. The resulting attempt records actual agent principal, pinned snapshot, runner, runtime session, sandbox, mode and human collaborator. Inventory updates never rewrite historical execution identity.
terms: "I07-I09: ExecutionGateway calls AgentExecution's owner operation with an immutable ChannelSession origin and instruction. The resulting attempt records actual agent principal, pinned snapshot, runner, runtime session, sandbox, mode and human collaborator. Inventory updates never rewrite historical execution identity."

children.name: I10: Resolve local agent identity from the installation and local agent binding. Equal names, content fingerprints or prompts across installations never merge agent principals. A personal agent's involvement needs no permanent channel membership or administrative participant admission.
terms: "I10: Resolve local agent identity from the installation and local agent binding. Equal names, content fingerprints or prompts across installations never merge agent principals. A personal agent's involvement needs no permanent channel membership or administrative participant admission."

children.name: I11: Reader checks current channel access before returning chat, typed artifacts, runs, summaries and shared history. Tickets/artifacts require authorization through their own workstream channel even when referenced by another channel. Unknown placement is denied. Recheck access before returning a completed context read.
terms: "I11: Reader checks current channel access before returning chat, typed artifacts, runs, summaries and shared history. Tickets/artifacts require authorization through their own workstream channel even when referenced by another channel. Unknown placement is denied. Recheck access before returning a completed context read."

children.name: I12-I16: Open authenticates a current Active Human opaque session and validates runner, local agent and immutable snapshot binding. Requested operations and tools/skills may only narrow human channel rights and the snapshot's effective capabilities. Submitted IDs cannot establish authority.
terms: "I12-I16: Open authenticates a current Active Human opaque session and validates runner, local agent and immutable snapshot binding. Requested operations and tools/skills may only narrow human channel rights and the snapshot's effective capabilities. Submitted IDs cannot establish authority."

children.name: A session credential is opaque and verifier-only at rest. Opening returns credential only upon issuance, never from session reads or events. An identical opening clientKey scoped to the human and local runtime session returns the same session; differing bindings or content fail ChannelWorkConflict. Concurrent independent local sessions may share a channel.
terms: "A session credential is opaque and verifier-only at rest. Opening returns credential only upon issuance, never from session reads or events. An identical opening clientKey scoped to the human and local runtime session returns the same session; differing bindings or content fail ChannelWorkConflict. Concurrent independent local sessions may share a channel."

children.name: Delegation expiry is bounded by the current human session expiry and the requested expiry. Renewal requires fresh current human session authority for the same principal, rechecks channel access, runner and snapshot restrictions, and cannot reopen Closed delegation or widen capabilities. Close is idempotent and atomically revokes its verifier.
terms: "Delegation expiry is bounded by the current human session expiry and the requested expiry. Renewal requires fresh current human session authority for the same principal, rechecks channel access, runner and snapshot restrictions, and cannot reopen Closed delegation or widen capabilities. Close is idempotent and atomically revokes its verifier."

children.name: Every delegated action requires the HTTP-proven current runner key plus delegation credential, a matching installation/session binding, allowed operation, unexpired Active human session/account, and current human channel membership. A runner ID/key ID or connectivity record alone grants no rights. Server time determines acceptance and expiry.
terms: "Every delegated action requires the HTTP-proven current runner key plus delegation credential, a matching installation/session binding, allowed operation, unexpired Active human session/account, and current human channel membership. A runner ID/key ID or connectivity record alone grants no rights. Server time determines acceptance and expiry."

children.name: Publication derives agent author and target channel solely from validated authority, records human collaborator and delegation provenance, and routes normal text through Messaging. A human announcement uses the human Messaging route. No text parsing creates reservations, status transitions or implicit agent requests.
terms: "Publication derives agent author and target channel solely from validated authority, records human collaborator and delegation provenance, and routes normal text through Messaging. A human announcement uses the human Messaging route. No text parsing creates reservations, status transitions or implicit agent requests."

children.name: A context manifest records actual message versions/hashes, ticket revisions and artifact versions/hashes. The start gateway validates that referenced content was authorized and delivered. A manifest is evidence of consumed context, not an exclusive or immutable guarantee; later version differences remain observable. Progress is separate from ordinary conversation prompt history.
terms: "A context manifest records actual message versions/hashes, ticket revisions and artifact versions/hashes. The start gateway validates that referenced content was authorized and delivered. A manifest is evidence of consumed context, not an exclusive or immutable guarantee; later version differences remain observable. Progress is separate from ordinary conversation prompt history."

children.name: I39: Continue uses RunHistory's authorized sealed snapshot and AgentExecution's owner operation to create a new run, new attempt and new runtime session with source run/attempt/snapshot/summary and workspace artifact provenance. Parallel continuations never mutate the source run. Imported tool calls remain history and are never executed. Missing workspace evidence or incompatible native checkpoints fails explicitly.
terms: "I39: Continue uses RunHistory's authorized sealed snapshot and AgentExecution's owner operation to create a new run, new attempt and new runtime session with source run/attempt/snapshot/summary and workspace artifact provenance. Parallel continuations never mutate the source run. Imported tool calls remain history and are never executed. Missing workspace evidence or incompatible native checkpoints fails explicitly."

children.name: I43: The root conversation budget identity is derived from durable originating run ancestry, including nested requests and continuations, and must match the request rootId. A caller cannot reset the budget with a fresh rootId. An explicit agent request derives requesting identity/channel from valid lease plus permanent participation or limited delegation. Target work must belong to the same currently authorized channel and retain a readable sealed history snapshot. If its runtime session is unavailable, create a linked continuation; do not take over the reviewer's session.
terms: "I43: The root conversation budget identity is derived from durable originating run ancestry, including nested requests and continuations, and must match the request rootId. A caller cannot reset the budget with a fresh rootId. An explicit agent request derives requesting identity/channel from valid lease plus permanent participation or limited delegation. Target work must belong to the same currently authorized channel and retain a readable sealed history snapshot. If its runtime session is unavailable, create a linked continuation; do not take over the reviewer's session."

children.name: Budget is scoped to a server-validated root conversation identity, never a freely reset client counter. At most eight requests may be consumed and at most two may be open. Admission, budget increment, request persistence and durable publication/dispatch work are atomic. Identical retries do not consume budget twice; different content conflicts.
terms: "Budget is scoped to a server-validated root conversation identity, never a freely reset client counter. At most eight requests may be consumed and at most two may be open. Admission, budget increment, request persistence and durable publication/dispatch work are atomic. Identical retries do not consume budget twice; different content conflicts."

children.name: Answer or cancellation decrements the open count exactly once while preserving consumed count. An answer must be a persisted message authored by the request's target agent and linked authorized reply run in the same channel. Completion/cancellation retries preserve their first result and audit time. HumanMessage triggers remain restricted to humans.
terms: "Answer or cancellation decrements the open count exactly once while preserving consumed count. An answer must be a persisted message authored by the request's target agent and linked authorized reply run in the same channel. Completion/cancellation retries preserve their first result and audit time. HumanMessage triggers remain restricted to humans."

children.name: All foreign writes occur through owner-defined execution, messaging and history contracts. Collaboration mutation and durable follow-up work commit together using one shared transaction context; nested document transactions are unsupported. Business failures roll back partial writes. Realtime follows persistence and retries never duplicate messages, events, trigger dispatch or notifications.
terms: "All foreign writes occur through owner-defined execution, messaging and history contracts. Collaboration mutation and durable follow-up work commit together using one shared transaction context; nested document transactions are unsupported. Business failures roll back partial writes. Realtime follows persistence and retries never duplicate messages, events, trigger dispatch or notifications."
